# PPR Release - Feb. 8 2024

_Category: Past Releases · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**Fareen** (2/9/2024):

For Personal Property Registry users: 
The secured party code search now respects codes with leading zeros in order to return a more accurate set of results.  This means for a Registering party code such as 40100, you need to enter 00040100.  
To look up all secured party codes belonging to head office id # 4, enter 0004. (#19436)
